reviews.title: Reasons on why Nooze is good or not
reviews.text:
So far I LOVE snooze!! I like how it asks what your habits are when it comes to sleeping in and not sleeping. The only thing I do NOT like is that I have to pay just to fix my sleep schedule. I think it would be better if certain things in the app cost money instead of having to pay to just use it. 

Sincerely 
- A broke sleeper

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text: It’s free helps u with motivation and helps with depression

reviews.title: Why is it a subscription??
reviews.text: I have been sleeping a little late lately, so I decided to download this app. When I download the app I thought it was gonna be free so I did the little questions page, but when I got to the end, it tried to make me pay a subscription. I have been going around on TikTok looking for different apps just like this, but I haven’t found one that has no subscription. I’m very disappointed. It had me excited for what.

reviews.title: Money
reviews.text: I was gonna download the app to help me with sleeping in but knowing you have to pay and nobody included that in the videos I seen is crazy I just can’t afford it and with the free trial I can’t rely on it and then when times up and I have to start paying I then have to delete the app.

reviews.title: Why Nooze is good for you
reviews.text: Nooze is amazing for me and for others by waking up with a mission. You see without Nooze you wouldn’t be up in minutes, you will still be in bed contemplating on if you should get up or not. With Nooze you have that one mission that would get you up instantly, like pushups or a math problem. All and all this is why Nooze is a good app to use to get you up and ready for your day.

reviews.title: Booze
reviews.text: Good but you have to pay

reviews.title: Doesn’t work consistently
reviews.text:
Great idea but buggy. The alarm went off randomly in the middle of my work day when I hadn’t set it prior. 
I also tried the scavenger hunt feature and it wouldn’t register anything I found, even with good lighting and clear photos. Tried multiple rounds of objects. I had to delete the whole app to get it to stop.

reviews.title: You have to pay
reviews.text: I was really exited to use this app but once I was making my account it made me pay and the alarm never went on

reviews.title: Can’t shut off alarm
reviews.text: My alarm went off this morning, when I went to complete my task it said “cannot verify - check your connection.” I have the setting in the app that doesn’t allow me to delete it when an alarm is going off, turned on, so now I can’t delete the app and re download it. At the time of writing this it is 9 pm and my alarm went off at 6:15 am. Still cannot get the app to work right. The only way I got the alarm to turn off was to go into my device settings and turn off all alarms for the app and notifications. This app works great until this decided to happen.

reviews.title: Stop snoozing
reviews.text: i love that when you downloaded, it was asking you questions I liked it but then when the questions were done, you have to like buy a subscription and I feel like that’s a waste of money

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Set the alarm hoping to wake up but no. Had dnd off notifications on, volume all the way up but still nothing went off. I had missed work and got fired because I never called in late as I was not intended to be. HORRIBLE

reviews.title: A must have
reviews.text:
I have never been good at getting up on time, but since downloading this app, I’ve noticed a real difference in how productive my mornings are. I love the “make your bed” task because it makes me get right up and starts my day right!

If you’re someone who struggles waking up or just bed rots after your alarm goes off, I really recommend giving this a try. You always get this feeling of accomplishment after finishing your morning task!!

reviews.title: This alarm actually forces you to wake up
reviews.text:
i used to snooze my alarms like 10 times and still be late. Downloaded Nooze and it literally won’t stop ringing until you finish a mission. I set mine to pushups and by the time i’m done im fully awake.

It’s lowkey brutal but it actually works. If you’re someone who always snoozes alarms, this is the only app that’s forced me out of bed.

reviews.title: Paid slop
reviews.text: Literally first morning my alarm never went off and I was late for work and my boss got really mad at me. Saw for on tik tok and it was a complete failure for me it just never worked.
